title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 282 (Smart Seal & Signature Converter)
highlights: Smart Seal & Signature Camera Photo-to-PNG: Snap a camera photo of your physical rubber seal or paper signature directly from your Android phone. The app erases paper shadows and background to produce a transparent PNG.
Auto-Crop & Ink Enhancer: Automatically crops excess white margins and offers official stamp ink colors (Classic Blue, Stamp Violet, Jet Black, Official Red, Stamp Green) or authentic original ink.
1-Tap Apply to Invoices: Instantly sets as Company Seal or Authorised Signature on invoices, quotations, and receipts.
Fast Background Isolate Processing: Image processing runs smoothly in a background thread without lag.
fixes: Integrated SmartStampService and SmartStampConverterDialog for camera & gallery photo processing.
Added direct Photo-to-PNG buttons in Invoice & PDF Document Settings.
Optimized transparent PNG storage and PDF rendering for mobile billing.
